title: Implement Brave free-mode admission control
description: Add concurrency-safe local admission control for PI_SEARCH_BRAVE_FREE_ONLY mode. Preserve provider-reported multi-window quota observations and retry metadata, avoid claiming billing certainty, and prevent bursts that violate a configured conservative interval. Validate behavior with concurrent/offline tests and update policy docs to distinguish free credits from a separate endpoint.

logs.msg: Implemented concurrency-safe local request-start spacing. Free-only index construction configures a 1s interval; provider-reported quota windows remain authoritative and no billing guarantee is claimed. Added cancellation/concurrency tests and updated README/provider policy. Focused Brave/router/index tests and typecheck pass.
